description: anaStruct is a Python structural analysis package for two-dimensional frames and trusses. It represents beams, supports, springs and loads, then computes bending moments, shear and axial forces and displacements. Users specify a line-element system and load cases in Python; output diagrams and numeric results describe the selected structural configuration. Its scope is an individual planar structure such as a frame or bridge cross-section, not an area-wide infrastructure network. The README documents installation, load combinations, elements and examples. GitHub metadata identifies LGPL-3.0 licence terms. A limitation is the two-dimensional assumption: three-dimensional torsion, complex connections and spatial load paths require another method. The library can test preliminary structural responses to infrastructure loads or hazards after input assumptions are checked. The related OpenSees catalogue record covers a different structural analysis program and does not subsume anaStruct. No installation, load data or software archive was downloaded.
inputs: Planar members, materials, supports and load cases
